verdict.oneLineSummary: Gated by severe API paywalls ($100/mo to $5,000/mo) and restrictive monthly rate limits.

twoClocks.anyUserCanConnect: Immediate once paid subscription ($100/mo Basic or $5,000/mo Pro) is approved

cost: Free tier has extreme limits. Basic tier is $100/mo; Pro tier is $5,000/mo.

capabilityCheck.question: Can an agent search recent tweets or read user timelines for free?
capabilityCheck.detail: SEVERE CAPABILITY & COST CEILING: Reading tweets or searching user timelines is completely blocked on the Free tier. Searching recent tweets requires at least the Basic tier ($100/mo), which caps results at 10,000 tweets/mo. Full archive search requires the Enterprise tier ($42,000/yr). Free tier is practically write-only.
capabilityCheck.warningCallout: If your agent requires reading tweets or monitoring keywords, you cannot launch without a credit card paying minimum $100/month.
